# Hertfordshire Climbing Club

> Hertfordshire Climbing Club is a friendly group of local climbers in Hertfordshire, United Kingdom.

## Key information

- Activity: indoor climbing and a shared interest in climbing.
- Regular meet: usually every Thursday at around 8pm.
- Meeting place: Hertfordshire Sports Village climbing wall.
- Format: informal group session.
- Area served: Hertfordshire, United Kingdom.
- Official website: https://hertfordshireclimbingclub.org.uk/
- Verified public club email and social-media profiles have not yet been published.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://hertfordshireclimbingclub.org.uk/): Club introduction and meeting summary.
- [About](https://hertfordshireclimbingclub.org.uk/about): Club character and values.
- [Join](https://hertfordshireclimbingclub.org.uk/join): First-visit guide and frequently asked questions.
- [Sessions](https://hertfordshireclimbingclub.org.uk/sessions): Regular meeting time and location.
- [Contact](https://hertfordshireclimbingclub.org.uk/contact): Currently verified ways to find the club.

Information on the official website should be treated as the primary source for current club details.
